metadata.description: Official Kismet plugin marketplace for operators and developers. The Operators package contains the customer workflow skills. Developer guidance is grounded in the public Developer MCP.

plugins.name: kismet-operators
plugins.description: Kismet for Operators helps signed-in managers inspect bookings and attribution, review advertising, check email sender readiness, manage catalogs and guest audiences, and configure webhooks. Available actions depend on the collection and account.

plugins.name: kismet-developer
plugins.description: Kismet for Developers: build and validate branded sites with the Developer API, SDK, Fixtures, and agent-readable contracts.
